verdict.rationale: Flagright documents ways to inspect automated outcomes: GET user returns the rule execution results, alerts can be retrieved, and its AI agents are marketed as explainable. Humans can also change case and alert statuses (OPEN/CLOSED/ESCALATED/CLEARED, custom statuses), which acts as an override of automated flags. Nothing shows that an override keeps the original automated evidence and rationale intact, and the explainability claim is marketing only. missing for 10: documented override of AI/automated remediation decisions, explicit preservation of original evidence and rationale (audit trail/versioning) after override, first-party docs on AI agent decision inspection, independent or hands-on corroboration
